answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: each new identity's rewards stay locked for 30 epochs and drip out like nectar only while its answers keep passing out-of-cluster review. An attacker spinning up a thousand wallets must fund their stakes up front and wait, and any slash before vesting burns the whole locked pile. Like a dune built grain by grain, honest history accrues slowly; fake reputation is a pigment that washes off at the first audit, taking the deposit with it.
